scope: Chrome closes with YouTube, and a new way to hear capital letters.

topics.title: Say cap for capital letters
details: There is a new choice for capital letters. It is called say cap.
Find it in Options, then Verbosity.
You hear cap just before a capital letter, with no pause. For example, cap B.
By voice, say capital letters say cap.

topics.title: Chrome closes with YouTube
details: Did Companion open Chrome for YouTube? Then that Chrome window now closes when YouTube closes.
It closes when you go to the main menu, or leave YouTube with nothing playing. It also closes when you close Companion.
A Chrome window you opened yourself stays open. Only the YouTube tab closes.
